```plato
    // Both diagonals of every cell.
    GridShearSprings(self: ClothGrid3D, compliance: Number): Array<ClothDistanceConstraint>
    {
        var columns = (self.ColumnCount - 1).Max(0);
        var rows = (self.RowCount - 1).Max(0);
        return (columns * rows * 2).MapRange(n =>
            self.GridShearSpring(n / 2 % columns, n / 2 / columns, n % 2, compliance));
    }
```
